Hello! I'm a big fan of your art! I love the way you draw chibis and the backgrounds you make for your works! I want to request you to draw my character here, some information about him:

-He's the guardian of a theme park
-his personality is elegant, caring and friendly
-He is associated with the carousel and other amusement park attractions

In the references there are two versions of his color palette, I would like you to draw him in his orange-hair color, but if you want to draw both colors, feel free to! You can also simplify his design to see fit. I think your artstyle would fit this character perfectly, thank you for considering my request!
